Draws exactly 10 seeded-random numbers per call (`seededRng((dup.seed+k*7919)>>>0)`, ORDER-SENSITIVE: rx,ry,rrr,rsx,rsy,rop for position/rotation/scale/opacity, then rz,rrx,rry for the 3D axes, then rhue LAST — appended after the original 9 so every pre-existing duplicator's random pattern stays byte-identical).
